Hollywood Pinball.name: Hollywood Pinball
Hollywood Pinball.summary: Hollywood Pinball is an Action game, developed by Tarantula Studios and published by Starfish, which was released in 1999.

Metal Gear Solid.name: Metal Gear: Ghost Babel
Metal Gear Solid.summary: Metal Gear: Ghost Babel is a Game Boy Color spinoff of the popular stealth action game Metal Gear Solid. This is not a port of said game but an original game made specifically for the Game Boy Color. Metal Gear: Ghost Babel is a non-canon game that serves as an alternate sequel to the events of the original Metal Gear.

Super Breakout!.name: Super Breakout
Super Breakout!.summary: Game Boy Color port of Super Breakout.

Wacky Races.name: Wacky Races
Wacky Races.summary: Game Boy Color Wacky Races game, released to coincide with the release of the Wacky Races game for home consoles and the PC.
